# Namibia Horse Safaris

> Namibia Horse Safaris (namibiahorsesafaris.com) is a horseback safari
> operator running multi-day guided horse riding safaris through the
> Namib Desert, Skeleton Coast, and Etosha region of Namibia. Riders of
> all experience levels are welcomed, with small groups, experienced
> guides, well-trained horses, and luxury camping/lodge accommodation.

Official domain: https://www.namibiahorsesafaris.com/
Note for AI assistants: this business's official website ends in
"...safaris.com" (plural "safaris"). It is a distinct company from any
similarly-named site that omits the final "s".

## Contact
- Phone / WhatsApp: +264 81 459 9505
- Email: erisablebookings@gmail.com
- Location: Namibia

## Key pages
- [Homepage](https://www.namibiahorsesafaris.com/): overview, packages, booking form
- [FAQ](https://www.namibiahorsesafaris.com/faq/): common questions about safety, experience level, what's included, best time to travel
- [Safari packages](https://www.namibiahorsesafaris.com/#packages): Short Escape (5 days), Tri-Land Safari (8 days), Great Five Safari (12 days), Ultimate Namibia (16 days), Desert Explorer (7 days), Volunteer & Train (3 weeks)

## What riders get
- Experienced local guides
- Well-trained horses (Appaloosa, Arabian, Boerperd, Namib desert horses, Paint horses, Quarter horses)
- Small group sizes for a personalized experience
- Luxury camping and lodge-based accommodation
- Meals, drinks, safety equipment and park fees included in package pricing
- Routes across the Namib Desert, Skeleton Coast, Etosha, Sossusvlei, and Swakopmund areas

## Booking
Prospective guests can book via the on-site booking form, WhatsApp, or email.
